text:
ana: Quick thread — need webinar hook, 1-page bench narrative, and an SDR battlecard for competing vs cloud AI and infra vendors. short and usable.

priya: Hook idea: 'Serve smarter, ship faster.' Callout: economics + ops risk.

mike: Bench datapoints (draft): p50 120-200ms dedicated vs 220-400ms managed; p95 300-420ms vs 700-1100ms; cost delta 15-45% lower per-token. note: (internal lab, Q1-2026).

jordan: Routing rules draft: if ARR>=100k OR security_need==VPC OR mentions SLA -> route=ae_enterprise; elif latency_flag -> route=eng-ops-rapidbench; else -> sdr_nurture.

priya: Battlecard needs: 4 soundbites, 3 objection handlers, 2 demo prompts. Soundbites: 'Measure costs, don\u2019t guess', 'Serving-first optimizations', 'Fallbacks keep UX intact', 'One API across deployments'.

ana: Objections: price -> show workload model and savings range; reliability -> canary + automatic fallbacks; lock-in -> same API across hosted/dedicated/private.

ops-bot: created INF-5723 "Rapid bench for inbound latency leads" assigned to @mike.

ana: Deliverables by Fri: landing copy, bench one-pager, battlecard v0, routing snippet. Owners: ana, priya, mike, jordan. Will sync after drafts. :rocket:
